column3: comment  (MFL.exe sound engine helpers: positional sound effect voices; names marked inferred come from the call pattern; apply with RenameFns.java)

(effect, position*): when g_app_state is 3, starts every voice of the effect (table g_sfx_table: +0 first voice, +4 count) at the position with frequency 22050.0 (0x46AC4400) unless an effect 0x20 special case applies
(effect, position*, voice index): same for a single voice of an effect
(effect, position*, voice index): updates the position of a voice that is already playing (flag 2)
(voice, car): voice position = the car's current matrix position (12 callers)
(group, position* or null): starts the voices of a g_sound_groups record (+0x80 first voice, +0x84 count)
(?, position*, group): starts two voices of a group with a pitch ramp (inferred)
(?, position*): starts four voices of the set at 0x618C98 + 4 with a pitch ramp (inferred)
(voice, value, a, b): two FUN_005b8c70 calls on the voice's stream object (inferred)
restarts the streams that were stopped (inferred)
table of sound voices (pointer + float per entry, stride 8); voice +0x34 flags (2 = playing), +0x3C frequency, +0x58..+0x60 position, +0x30 audio object
sound effect table, stride 0x94: +0 first voice index, +4 voice count
pointer to sound group records of 0x90 bytes (+0x80 first voice, +0x84 count, +0x6B0 voice for the pitch ramp variant)
